name: issue_827_missing_forecast_fallback_escalates
description: GAP-2 (Issue #827 audit): the pre-#827 resolver only fell through to its sustain-confirmed fallback when confidence_k_passive was LITERALLY 'none'. A zone WITH thermal-model confidence (e.g. 'medium') but no cached comfort_floor_crossing_time (a missing forecast for this cycle) fell into a dead end instead — the ODE floor guard returns NO_BREACH_PREDICTED and nothing else picked up the slack. This scenario proves the consolidated FSM's fallback is now universal: any 'guard can't decide' outcome (NO_BREACH_PREDICTED here) falls through to the same sustain-confirm+deadband path the confidence-none case always used.
source: Issue #827 Design table, GAP-2 — a non-none-confidence zone with a missing floor-crossing forecast previously dead-ended instead of falling back.
notes: (a) Scenario effectiveness: if decide_comfort_family()'s heating-direction branch were reverted to gate the fallback strictly on confidence_k_passive=='none' (the pre-#827 shape), this scenario's NO_BREACH_PREDICTED outcome (confidence='medium', no comfort_floor_crossing_time ever supplied) would be treated as 'confidence not none, so no fallback' and the final assertion (comfort_family=heating) would FAIL — the engine would keep affirming the warm-day ceiling forever despite the confirmed floor breach.
(b) Docs<->production alignment: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md #6f documents the universal-fallback design (not confidence-gated) alongside this scenario as its test reference.

(c) Occupant experience: a zone with SOME thermal-model history (non-none confidence) but no cached floor-crossing prediction for this particular cycle (e.g. right after a model refresh, before the next ODE run repopulates the cache) previously had its comfort floor silently undefended — worse than a brand-new zone, since the confidence-none fallback that protected a brand-new zone explicitly excluded it. With this fix, the floor is defended the same way regardless of why the ODE guard couldn't decide.

The harness's classification event dispatcher (tools/sim_harness/run_production.py) always calls apply_classification() with comfort_floor_crossing_time=None (no scenario field threads a value through) — so 'confidence not none, no floor-crossing time' is simply the harness's normal default state whenever thermal_model.confidence is set to anything but 'none'. No special event is needed to reach NO_BREACH_PREDICTED; only the thermal_model config block distinguishes this scenario from issue_821_comfort_floor_fallback_no_confidence.json's MODEL_INELIGIBLE case.

events.note: Warm-day classification. Base_family resolves to 'cooling' (active=ceiling). Thermal model confidence is 'medium' (not 'none'), but no comfort_floor_crossing_time is ever supplied by this harness's classification dispatch -> decide_ode_floor_guard() returns NO_BREACH_PREDICTED every cycle.
Indoor has decayed to 65F, 3F below comfort_heat(68) — clears comfort_deadband_warm_f (default 2.0F).

First cycle with indoor below the floor. NO_BREACH_PREDICTED falls through to the universal sustain-confirm fallback (GAP-2 fix) -- arms the candidate, not yet confirmed (elapsed 0s < 90s). Stays 'cooling' this tick.

120s later (>90s). First-ever transition for this engine, so the 600s dwell floor doesn't gate it (cold start allows the first transition unconditionally). Sustain-confirmed: comfort family switches to heating.

assertions.reason: Baseline: warm day, indoor within band — comfort band arms normally.

GAP-2 fix: a zone with non-none thermal-model confidence but no cached floor-crossing prediction still reaches the universal fallback (rather than dead-ending) and escalates once the below-floor reading sustain-confirms.
The escalated mode is a real climate.set_temperature/set_hvac_mode call at comfort_heat.

verdict.summary: A zone with non-none thermal-model confidence but no cached floor-crossing forecast for this cycle still gets its comfort floor defended via the universal sustain-confirm fallback — closing GAP-2 from the Issue #827 audit.
verdict.observed_behavior: comfort family stays 'cooling' at 71F (in-band) and again at the first below-floor tick (08:30:00, unconfirmed); switches to 'heating' at 08:32:00 once sustain-confirmed.
verdict.expected_behavior: The comfort-floor fallback is never gated on confidence_k_passive literally being 'none' -- any ODE-guard outcome that can't itself decide (MODEL_INELIGIBLE, MISSING_TEMPS, or NO_BREACH_PREDICTED) falls through to the same universal fallback.
